biggest_catch: Below 1,000 kWh/month you get zero credit while still paying the plan's energy rate — the credit only rewards high usage.
catches: No credit at all below 1,000 kWh — the 'up to $50' is usage-gated.
36-month term with early termination fee ($150 shown on plan).
Credits are bill savings on energy you already buy, not cash.

steps: Enroll as a new Constellation customer on the Usage Bill Credit plan (Texas).
Use at least 1,000 kWh in a billing cycle to receive the $35 credit (2,000+ kWh for the extra $15).
Credits apply automatically on the monthly bill.
timing: Enrollment ~20 minutes online; credits apply each billing cycle automatically.
